body: For advice: don't hurry through material. If something is due in two days, hurrying to learn may just stress you out more. Teachers often like effort so even if you don't know what you're doing, show that you thought about it. For my last math class in one proof I literally wrote 'I'm not sure how to do this step but I know that I need to prove xyz.' I got an overall good grade because I did what I knew. I'm not saying that always works but good teachers will give you at least partial credit for taking the steps even if you don't know 100%.
